module_summary: 10G Ethernet MAC+PHY wrapper: a 64b/66b MAC/PHY instance sits between dual-clock AXI-stream TX and RX FIFOs, with toggle/level synchronizers for status and optional PTP timestamp CDC and TX timestamp FIFO.

anchors.name: tx_axis_tdata
anchors.why: 64-bit transmit AXI-stream payload entering the TX FIFO.

anchors.name: tx_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Transmit stream valid into TX FIFO slave port.

anchors.name: tx_axis_tready
anchors.why: TX FIFO ready back-pressure to the transmit source.

anchors.name: rx_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Received frame payload output from the RX FIFO.

anchors.name: rx_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: RX FIFO output valid for received stream.

anchors.name: rx_axis_tready
anchors.why: Downstream ready controlling RX FIFO reads.

anchors.name: serdes_tx_data
anchors.why: Scrambled 64b/66b transmit block data to SERDES from MAC/PHY.

anchors.name: serdes_rx_data
anchors.why: Receive block data from SERDES into the MAC/PHY.

anchors.name: serdes_tx_hdr
anchors.why: 64b/66b sync header for transmit blocks.

anchors.name: serdes_rx_hdr
anchors.why: 64b/66b sync header for received blocks.

anchors.name: serdes_rx_bitslip
anchors.why: Bitslip request to SERDES for block alignment.

anchors.name: serdes_rx_reset_req
anchors.why: SERDES receiver reset request from the PHY.

anchors.name: tx_fifo_axis_tdata
anchors.why: TX FIFO output stream feeding MAC transmit in tx_clk domain.

anchors.name: tx_fifo_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Valid from TX FIFO to MAC transmit path.

anchors.name: rx_fifo_axis_tdata
anchors.why: MAC receive stream written into the RX FIFO.

anchors.name: rx_fifo_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: MAC receive valid writing the RX FIFO.

anchors.name: tx_error_underflow
anchors.why: Synchronized TX underflow pulse from toggle synchronizer.

anchors.name: rx_error_bad_frame
anchors.why: Synchronized RX bad-frame pulse from toggle synchronizer bit 0.

anchors.name: rx_error_bad_fcs
anchors.why: Synchronized RX bad-FCS pulse from toggle synchronizer bit 1.

anchors.name: rx_bad_block
anchors.why: Synchronized bad 64b/66b block pulse.

anchors.name: rx_block_lock
anchors.why: Synchronized PHY block-lock level from rx_sync_reg_4.

anchors.name: rx_high_ber
anchors.why: Synchronized high bit-error-rate level.

anchors.name: rx_status
anchors.why: Synchronized receive link status level.

anchors.name: tx_sync_reg_1
anchors.why: Toggle register in tx_clk flipping on underflow events for CDC.

anchors.name: rx_sync_reg_1
anchors.why: rx_clk capture of error toggles and lock/BER/status levels for CDC.

anchors.name: tx_fifo_overflow
anchors.why: TX FIFO overflow status.

anchors.name: rx_fifo_overflow
anchors.why: RX FIFO overflow status.

anchors.name: m_axis_tx_ptp_ts_valid
anchors.why: TX PTP timestamp valid from timestamp FIFO; tied 0 when PTP disabled.

anchors.name: m_axis_tx_ptp_ts_96
anchors.why: Transmit PTP timestamp output from timestamp FIFO.

anchors.name: tx_ptp_ts_96
anchors.why: PTP time converted into tx_clk domain feeding MAC timestamping.

anchors.name: rx_ptp_ts_96
anchors.why: PTP time converted into rx_clk domain feeding MAC timestamping.

anchors.name: cfg_ifg
anchors.why: Inter-frame gap configuration passed to MAC.

anchors.name: cfg_tx_enable
anchors.why: Enables MAC transmit path.

anchors.name: cfg_rx_enable
anchors.why: Enables MAC receive path.

groups.name: tx_fifo
groups.description: Async AXI-stream FIFO moving transmit frames from logic_clk to tx_clk.

groups.name: mac_phy_10g
groups.description: 10G MAC with 64b/66b PCS converting frames to SERDES blocks.

groups.name: rx_fifo
groups.description: Async AXI-stream FIFO moving received frames from rx_clk to logic_clk.

groups.name: status_sync
groups.description: Toggle and level synchronizers bringing MAC/PHY status into logic_clk.

groups.name: ptp_timestamp
groups.description: Optional PTP clock CDC and TX timestamp async FIFO, disabled by default.
